_readme: Supplier Intelligence research file (manual CMS, no build step, no scraping, no auto-generation). Add one object per supplier to 'suppliers'. Only entries with "published": true appear on /supplier-search. Never publish a supplier unless the facts came from our own research, outreach or visit. verification_status is a 4-level ladder describing HOW we know what we know, not a ranking: public_checked (registry / listing reviewed) < supplier_contacted (we reached out, got a reply) < documents_reviewed (license, catalog or spec sheet reviewed) < factory_visited (SourciaVera team physically on-site). buyer_types: pick from small_importer | regional_distributor | amazon_seller | large_wholesaler | oem_buyer. insight is SourciaVera's own buyer-side judgment (a sentence of advice), separate from notes (factual observations). risk_level: low | medium | high | unknown — our read at verified_on, not a permanent rating.

suppliers.insight: SourciaVera Insight: suitable for buyers needing complete spare wheel kits for Chinese EV models, in small trial batches before scaling. Confirm export experience and current capacity before a large order.
suppliers.notes: Registered and production addresses matched; issued a stamped spec sheet before sample order after the first version mixed up offset and center bore.
